caption: The drawing depicts a lidded urn with a wide, flaring top, a bulbous body that tapers to a narrower base, and stands on a round pedestal. The body of the urn appears to be shaded in tones of grey, suggesting a metallic surface, and has two small, symmetrically placed handles on each side. There is an ornate, gold-colored spigot mounted near the bottom, flanked by decorative elements extending outward. The lid has a pointed finial with detailing. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller profile outline of the urn with precise measurements (12¼” high and 8¼” wide), and a depiction of the handle and tap mechanism. Below the urn, within a circular boundary, the name "R. GLEASON" is inscribed, and beneath that is the note "INSCRIPTION INSIDE BOTTOM." The overall composition is set within a rectangular border on a tan or off-white background.
title: Pewter Coffee Urn
